nodes.name: Co₃W(111) surface AIMD
nodes.procedure: The trajectory of H moving on the Co₃W(111) surface through AIMD was obtained and then the SchNet model was trained to construct the ML calculator.

nodes.name: SchNet MLP training
nodes.procedure: SchNet model trained on 2460 trajectories (≈38484 structures) of H atom adsorbed on ontop and bridge sites of alloy surfaces. MAE of energies and forces: 0.1259 eV and 0.0171 eV Å⁻¹ for test set.
nodes.source_text: We then trained the SchNet model based on 2460 trajectories (≈38484 structures and data) of H atom adsorbed on the ontop and bridge sites of alloy surfaces...

nodes.name: ML calculator optimization
nodes.procedure: The guessed structure was optimized based on the ML calculator to achieve the convergence criteria (0.05 eV Å⁻¹).

nodes.name: Large-scale alloy screening
nodes.procedure: The adsorption configurations were constructed for each adsorption site on the (111) surfaces of 823 alloys, and then they (15 566 in total) were further optimized based on the SchNet calculator.
nodes.source_text: the adsorption configurations were constructed for each adsorption site on the (111) surfaces of 823 alloys, and then they (15 566 in total) were further optimized...

nodes.name: HER catalyst screening
nodes.procedure: From 2974 binary alloys screened from Materials Project, 823 alloys selected (thermodynamically stable, convex hull energy = 0 eV, <40 atoms/cell). 15566 configurations on (111) surfaces optimized. 43 alloys identified as excellent HER catalysts (ΔE_H range -0.37 to -0.17 eV, >50% active sites).
nodes.source_text: Finally, 43 alloys were identified to be excellent HER catalysts... from 2974 binary alloys were screened out from MP database.

nodes.source_text: To further demonstrate the reliability of the screening model, the AgPd alloy... All sites exhibit good catalytic performance of HER (|ΔG_H| < 0.21 eV), in which more than half of these sites are considered as excellent catalytic sites for HER (|ΔG_H| < 0.10 eV).

nodes.description: SchNet model validation for H adsorption on Co3W(111) surface
nodes.source_text: Here Co3W alloy was chosen as an example... The bond lengths between the H atom and two nearest Co atoms are 1.682 and 1.625 Å respectively and the angle of Co-H-Co is 94.99° in the DFT optimized configuration while the corresponding bond lengths and bond angle of the structure optimized based on the SchNet calculator are 1.684 Å, 1.628 Å, and 94.81°, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: AIMD simulations (~1000 steps) at 300K used to collect training data for SchNet model of bulk Co₃W (2×2×2 supercell).
nodes.evidence_snippet: A 2×2×2 supercell of bulk Co₃W was constructed and ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations were used to collect the data within ≈1000 steps to train the model.

nodes.characterization_summary: AIMD trajectory on Co₃W(111) surface shows H atom moves from ontop site (H-Co 1.504 Å) to bridge site. DFT optimized bridge site has Co-H bonds 1.682 Å, 1.625 Å and Co-H-Co angle 94.99°.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The H atom was on the top site with an H-Co bond length of 1.504 Å in the initial configuration... After DFT or ML optimization, the H atom could move to the bridge site... The bond lengths between the H atom and two nearest Co atoms are 1.682 and 1.625 Å respectively and the angle of Co-H-Co is 94.99°.

nodes.characterization_summary: DFT calculations on AgPd(111) in vacuum show ΔE_H predictions from ML framework have MAE of 0.156 eV vs DFT. All sites show good HER performance (|ΔG_H| < 0.21 eV) with >half excellent sites (|ΔG_H| < 0.10 eV).
nodes.evidence_snippet: We compared the difference between the ΔE_H obtained by DFT and our framework... predicted values using our model are reasonably comparable with an MAE of 0.156 eV... All sites exhibit good catalytic performance of HER (|ΔG_H| < 0.21 eV), in which more than half of these sites are considered as excellent catalytic sites for HER (|ΔG_H| < 0.10 eV).
